blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Given that the Chinese are one of the oldest ethnic groups to immigrate to the US, their cuisine have become central to the US dining scene and an interesting avenue to study how Chinese immigrants have culturally adapted into American life. In that regard, previous research has focused on analyzing the English names that Chinese restaurants adopt, e.g., finding the use of familiar and typical words. To investigate how Chinese immigrants have culturally integrated in the US depending on social, geographic and demographic contexts, we investigate in this work the under-explored relationship between the Chinese and English names of American Chinese restaurants. Specifically, we conduct a study on 3,172 Chinese restaurants (10% of the total on Google Maps) sampled across the US. We present 8-dimension name frames to capture the underlying meanings behind names and create the NameFrames dataset containing 884 annotated parallel Chinese/English names. We also built an NLP pipeline to analyze the semantic discrepancies between names with both frame-based and embedding-based distance metrics. Our frame analysis shows that English names more often emphasize Location and Specialty, while Chinese names more often emphasize Positivity and Ambiance. Furthermore, we observe that for Chinese restaurants located in urban areas, those in counties with a higher concentration of Chinese population, or those that are relatively new, the discrepancies between the English and Chinese names are noticeably larger. Finally, interviews with 10 Chinese restaurant owners reveal additional interesting insights regarding naming conventions.
blocks.zh: 由于华人是移民到美国最古老的族群之一,他们的美食成为了美国餐饮场景的中心,也是研究华人移民如何从文化上适应美国生活的有趣途径. 在这方面,以往的研究侧重于分析中国餐馆采用的英文名称,例如,发现使用熟悉和典型的词汇。 为了调查中国移民如何根据社会、地理和人口背景在文化上融入美国,我们在这项工作中调查了美国中餐馆的中英文名称之间的未充分探讨的关系。 对美国各地的3,172家中餐馆(占Google地图上总数的10%)进行了研究。 我们提出8-dimension名称框架,以捕捉名称背后的基本含义并创建包含884个附加说明的中英文名称的NameFrames数据集. 我们还建造了NLP管道,以分析名称之间的语义差异,同时使用帧和嵌入式相距度量衡. 我们的框架分析显示,英文名称更经常地强调位置和特长,而中文名称更经常地强调可能性和安比昂斯. 此外,我们还注意到,对于位于城市地区的中餐馆、中国人口集中程度较高的县的餐馆或较新的餐馆,英文和中文名称之间的差异明显更大。 最后,与10名中国餐馆老板的访谈揭示出更多关于命名公约的有趣见解。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The process of immigrant groups adapting their language, values, and behaviors to a new society is commonly known as cultural assimilation in sociology and ethnic studies. The United States, colloquially hailed as “a melting pot”, has a long history of immigration and therefore provides a unique perspective to researchers to study this phenomenon. Among the diverse immigrant groups in the US, those of Chinese ethnicity (referred to as “Chinese”) hold a significant place, because their path to assimilation is not in a “straight-line” fashion Warner and Srole (1945) ; Alba and Nee (2014) but somehow “bumpy” and “segmented” Portes and Zhou (1993) ; Zhou and Xiong (2005) . Over time, Chinese immigrants have established themselves through the restaurant business, which is central to the dining scene in the United States. Different from other ethnic restaurants in the US, Chinese restaurants usually have parallel names in English and Chinese, which sometimes do not match in meaning (Figure 1 ). These parallel names reflect both an embrace of cultural assimilation and a preservation of their home culture identity to Chinese immigrants. This paper provides a systematic analysis of this cultural phenomenon by investigating patterns of divergence between Chinese and English names for over three thousand American Chinese restaurants (ACRs).
blocks.zh: 移民群体使其语言,价值观和行为适应新社会的过程被通称为社会学和民族学的文化同化. 美国被誉为“熔炉”,有着悠久的移民历史,因此为研究人员研究这一现象提供了独特的视角。 在美国各种移民群体中,华人(被称作"华人")占据了重要地位,因为他们的同化之路不是"一线"时尚"华纳和斯克勒(1945年);阿尔巴和尼(2014年),而是不知何故"狂躁"和"被分割"的波斯和周(1993年);周和相(2005年). 随着时间的推移,华人移民通过餐厅业务建立自己,餐馆业务是美国餐饮场景的中心. 与美国其他民族餐馆不同,中餐馆通常有英文和中文的平行名称,有时在含义上并不相匹配(图一. 这些平行名称既体现了对文化同化的拥抱,也体现了对中国移民的自有文化认同. 本文通过调查三千多家美籍华人餐馆(ACR)中英文名相去甚远的规律,系统地分析了这种文化现象.

blocks.en: Prior work has used ACR menus and reviews Chen and Park (2021) ; Luo et al. (2023) to study cultural assimilation of the Chinese community. This work focuses on names because names represent how people define and mark their own cultural identity and we are interested in studying how ACR owners represent themselves as immigrants from their ACR naming practice. Ferdman and Ingraham (2016) and Chin and others (2023) have observed that ACR English names frequently feature cultural symbols such as “panda”, “dragon”, and “wok”. Through a qualitative analysis on 423 ACRs in Los Angeles County, Chen (2018) further categorized ACR names into various frames such as Place Names . This study revealed how ACR owners demonstrate cultural assimilation through the adoption of English names, terms evoking modern European sensibility, and concepts related to American fast-food takeout. However, previous research has never compared the Chinese names with the accompanying English names in ACRs.
blocks.zh: 前作使用ACR菜单并评论了"陈和朴"(2021年);"罗等"(2023年)研究了华人社群的文化同化. 这部作品关注地名,因为地名代表人们如何定义和标出自己的文化特征,我们有兴趣研究ACR所有者如何从ACR命名实践中将自己视为移民. Ferdman和Ingraham(2016年)以及Chin等人(2023年)观察到,ACR的英文名经常以"panda","dragon"和"wok"等文化符号为特色. 通过对洛杉矶县423个ACR的定性分析,陈(2018年)进一步将ACR名称分入了"地名"等多个框架. 这项研究揭示了ACR所有者如何通过采用英文名称,引用现代欧洲感知性术语,以及与美国快餐外卖有关的概念来展示文化同化. 然而,之前的研究从未将中文名与ACRs中相伴随的英文名相提并论.

blocks.en: This paper presents a novel study on the cultural assimilation of Chinese in American society by focusing, as a case study, on the phenomenon of systematic discrepancies between parallel English and Chinese names in ACRs. We sampled 3,172 American Chinese restaurants (ACRs), 10% of the total on Google Maps, across the US and enrolled crowdworkers (67 hours in total) to transcribe their Chinese names by reviewing Google Map photos and websites. Building on Chen (2018) ’s work, we adapt 8-dimension name frames to capture various aspects of the underlying meaning of names. To automate the analysis, we build an NLP pipeline to compare the discrepancies between the parallel names with both frame-based and embedding-based distance metrics. Finally, we examine how the difference in names is correlated with socio-contextual factors, contributing significantly to our understanding of this unique cultural practice. Our main contributions are as follows: • We present a novel study that examines the cultural assimilation of Chinese in the US and uncovers systematic semantic discrepancies between English and Chinese names of ACRs. • We adapt 8-dimension name frames based on prior work to capture underlying meanings of names and create the NameFrames dataset on 884 pairs of ACR names. • We build an NLP pipeline to quantify semantic discrepancies with two metrics, showing that for ACRs in urban areas, those in counties with a higher percent of Chinese, or those that are relatively new, the discrepancies between their parallel names are significantly larger. • We conduct ten qualitative interviews with ACR owners to further complement the computational analysis, which helps us better understand their motivations and experiences behind their naming practices.
blocks.zh: 本文通过将ACRs中平行英文和中文名称的系统差异现象作为案例研究,对美国社会中华人的文化同化问题进行了一则小说研究. 我们从Google地图上抽取了3,172家美式华人餐馆,占总数的10%, 在陈(2018年)工作的基础上,我们改用"八分法"命名框架,以捕捉名字基本含义的各个方面. 为了使分析自动化,我们建造了NLP管道,以比较平行名称与以帧和嵌入为主的距离度量衡之间的差异。 最后,我们审查名称差异如何与社会-文字因素相联,大大地促进了我们对这一独特文化习俗的理解。 我们的主要贡献如下: 我们介绍了一项新颖的研究,研究了美国华人的文化同化,并揭示了ACR的英文和中文名称之间的系统性语义差异. 我们根据先前的工作修改了8-dimension名称框架,以捕捉名称的基本含义并创建884对ACR名称上的NameFrames数据集. ^ 我们建造了一个NLP管道,以量化语义上与两个度量的相差,表明对于城市地区的ACR,在中文比例较高的郡,或者相对新的郡,其平行名称之间的差异要大得多. ^ 我们与ACR所有者进行了10次定性访谈,以进一步补充计算分析,帮助我们更好地了解他们命名的动机和经验。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Names of American Chinese Restaurants
blocks.zh: 2.1 美国华人餐馆名称

blocks.en: Traditionally, running American Chinese restaurants (ACRs) is an important means of livelihood for Chinese immigrants in the United States, leading to the birth of what we now know as American Chinese cuisine Coe (2009) . For instance, the American national condiment “ketchup” is linked to the history of Fujianese immigrants opening Chinese restaurants in New York City Jurafsky (2014) . Researchers from Washington Post Ferdman and Ingraham (2016) and Smithsonians 1 1 1 https://www.smithsonianmag.com/smithsonian-institution/why-do-chinese-restaurants-such-similar-names-\180961996/ noticed that the English names of ACRs tend to be similar and stereotypical, such as “wok”, “garden”, “dragon”, etc. Chen (2018) did a qualitative study on the English naming practices of 423 ACRs in Los Angeles County, demonstrating how these names, through the incorporation of various name frames such as region names, family names, and transliterated hanzi, reflect the diversity within Chinese culinary traditions and the immigrants’ adaptation to American culture. Despite these insightful contributions, none of the previous work delved into the patterns existing between parallel English and Chinese names of ACRs. Previous studies have predominantly focused on the English names of these restaurants Liu and Lin (2009) ; Ferdman and Ingraham (2016) ; Chen (2018) ; Li (2019) , often overlooking the rich cultural narratives and adaptive strategies embedded in the parallel names. The discrepancies between these parallel names can offer a deeper understanding of the cultural adaptation processes of Chinese immigrants and their attempts to negotiate identity and representation in a multicultural context.
blocks.zh: 传统上,经营美国华人餐馆(ACRs)是美国华人移民的重要生计手段,导致我们现在所知的"美国华人美食"(2009年)的诞生. 例如,美国国家餐厅“ketchup”与福建移民在纽约市Jurafsky开设中餐馆的历史(2014年)有关。 来自华盛顿邮报Ferdman和Ingraham的研究人员(2016年)和Smithsonians 1 1 1 https://www.smithsonianmag.com/smithsonian-insstitution/why-do-chinese-restarants-such-similar-names-\18096-1996/ 注意到ACRs的英文名称往往类似并带有成见,例如“wok”、“garden”、“dragon”等。 陈(2018)对洛杉矶县423个ACR的英文取名做法进行了定性研究,展示了这些取名方式如何通过纳入诸如地区名,姓氏等各种取名框架,并转写汉字来反映中国烹饪传统的多样性和移民对美国文化的适应. 尽管有这些有见地的贡献,以前的工作没有一项探讨ACR的平行英文和中文名称之间的模式。 以往的研究主要集中在这些餐厅的英文名称:刘和林(2009年);Ferdman和Ingraham (2016年);Chen (2018年);Li (2019年),经常会俯瞰嵌入于平行名称中的丰富的文化叙事和适应策略. 这些平行名称之间的差异可以使人们更深入地了解中国移民的文化适应进程,以及他们试图在多元文化背景下谈判身份和代表性。

blocks.en: 2.2 Computational Frame Analysis
blocks.zh: 2.2 计算框架分析

blocks.en: Prior work in NLP has presented various computational methods to automate framing analysis in large-scale datasets Ziems and Yang (2021) ; Ali and Hassan (2022) ; Ziems et al. (2023) . If there is no pre-annotated dataset or codebook, clustering algorithms Burscher et al. (2016) and topic modeling DiMaggio et al. (2013) ; Nguyen (2015) are two popular unsupervised approaches to analyze frames on large corpora. However, supervised neural networks are commonly applied to detect frames if there is an existing coding schema with enough annotated frame data for training Ali and Hassan (2022) , including probabilistic soft logic Johnson et al. (2017) , LSTM Naderi and Hirst (2017) , recursive neural network Ji and Smith (2017) , and transformer-based language models such as BERT Liu et al. (2019a) ; Tourni et al. (2021) , RoBERTa Khanehzar et al. (2019) ; Huguet Cabot et al. (2020) ; Mendelsohn et al. (2021) , XLM-RoBERTa Bhatia et al. (2021) , and MultiBERT Akyürek et al. (2020) . Recently, large language models have shown promising results to automate social science research Grossmann et al. (2023) ; Bail (2023) ; Rytting et al. (2023) ; Shen et al. (2023) ; Karjus (2023) , including automatic frame detection and analysis Ziems et al. (2023) ; Törnberg (2023) in a zero-shot or few-shot setting.
blocks.zh: 先前在NLP中的工作提出了各种计算方法,在大型数据集Ziems和Yang(2021);Ali和Hassan(2022);Ziems等(2023)。 如果没有预先附加说明的数据集或代码本,则分组算法为Burscher等(2016年)和专题模型为DiMaggio等(2013年);Nguyen(2015年)是在大公司上分析帧的两种受欢迎的无监督方法. 然而,如果现有编码计划有足够的附加说明的框架数据用于训练阿里和哈桑(2022年),则通常应用有监督的神经网络来检测帧,其中包括概率软逻辑强生等(2017年)、LSTM Naderi和Hirst(2017年)、递归神经网络智和Smith(2017年)以及基于变压器的语言模型,如BERT刘等(2019年a);Tourni等(2021年)、RoBERTa Khanehzar等(2019年)、Huguet Cabot等(2020年)、Mendelsohn等(2021年)、XLM-RoBERTBhatia等(2021年)和MultiBERT Akyürek等(2020年)。 最近,大型语言模型在社会科学研究Grossmann等(2023年);Bail等(2023年);Rytting等(2023年);Shen等(2023年);Karjus等(2023年),包括自动帧检测和分析Ziems等(2023年);Törnberg等(2023年)在零发或几发的设定中显示出有希望的结果.

blocks.en: 2.3 Measuring Semantic Textual Similarity
blocks.zh: 2.3 测量语义文字的相似性

blocks.en: Estimating the semantic textual similarity (STS) between text data is an open problem in NLP Chandrasekaran and Mago (2021) . In earlier approaches, two text snippets were considered similar if they contain the same words or n-grams. However, lexicon-matching methods such as BoW and TF-IDF fail to consider that different words can share similar meanings. To address the drawback of the lexical measures, prior work has proposed knowledge-based methods such as edge-counting Rada et al. (1989) and information content (IC)-based Sánchez et al. (2012) ; Zhu and Iglesias (2016) approaches, corpus-based methods such as LSA Landauer and Dumais (1997) and LDA Sinoara et al. (2019) , and neural networks-based methods such as word2vec Wang et al. (2016) ; Hamilton et al. (2016b) ; Hamilton et al. (2016a) ; Kutuzov et al. (2018) , LSTM Tai et al. (2015) , and CNN He and Lin (2016) to measure textual similarity or quantify semantic change. Recently, transformer-based models such as BERT Devlin et al. (2019) , RoBERTa Liu et al. (2019b) , DistilBERT Sanh et al. (2019) , and T5 Raffel et al. (2020) are pre-trained as language models and have been commmonly used to represent texts for measuring textual similarity. Reimers and Gurevych (2019) introduced Sentence-BERT (SBERT), which can derive semantically meaningful sentence embeddings that can be compared using cosine similarity. Reimers and Gurevych (2020) extended SBERT to support multiple languages. The most recent work in NLP focus on optimizing language models for STS Gao et al. (2021) ; Chuang et al. (2022) ; Wu et al. (2022) ; Jiang et al. (2022) ; Li and Li (2023) , improved smaller language models by generating synthetic data from LLMs Wang et al. (2023) , or scaling sentence embeddings to larger language models such as T5 Ni et al. (2021) and 2.7B OPT Jiang et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 估计文本数据之间的语义文本相似性(STS)是NLP Chandrasekaran和Mago(2021)中一个开放的问题. 在更早的方法中,如果两个文本片段包含相同的单词或正克,则被认为类似. 然而,BOW和TF-IDF等词汇比对方法未能考虑不同的词可以有相似的含义. 为解决法理措施的缺点,先前的工作提出了以知识为基础的方法,如边缘计数的Rada等人(1989年)和以信息内容(IC)为基础的Sánchez等人(2012年);Zhu和Iglesias(2016年)的方法,以体理为基础的方法,如LSA Landauer和Dumais(1997年)和LDA Sinoara等人(2019年),以及以神经网络为基础的方法,如Word2vec Wang等人(2016年);Hamilton等人(2016年b),Hamilton等人(2016年a),Kutuzov等人(2018年),LSTM Tai et al. (2015),和CNN He和Lin (2016) 测量文字相似性或量化语义变化. 最近,基于变压器的模型,如BERT Devlin等(2019年),RoBERTa Liu等(2019年b),DistilBERT等. Sanh等 (2019年),和T5 Raffel等 (2020年)作为语言模型进行预训,并被共通使用来代表用于测量文本相似性的文本. Reimers和Gurevich (2019)引入了Pried-BERT(SBERT),它可以从中衍生出意义深远的嵌入式句子,可以使用同位素相似性进行比较. Reimers and Gurevich (2020) 扩展了SBERT支持多种语言. NLP的最新工作重点是优化STS Gao等人(2021年);Chuang等人(2022年);Wu等人(2022年);Jiang等人(2022年);Li和Li (2023年)的语言模型,通过从LLMS Wang等人(2023年)生成合成数据改进了较小的语言模型,或将句子嵌入到T5 Ni等人(2021年)和2.7B OPS等较大的语言模型中. 蒋等 (2023).

blocks.en: 3 NameFrames Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 个名称Frames 数据集

blocks.en: We collected all American Chinese Restaurants (ACRs) with Google Maps API, sampled a subset of ACRs from each state across the U.S., and hired crowdworkers to double-transcribe Chinese names from online images. To quantify the information lost in translation, we adapted 8-dimensional name frames and created the NameFrames dataset. This dataset includes annotations of both English and Chinese names across 884 ACRs.
blocks.zh: 我们用Google Maps API收集了所有的美国华人餐馆,从全美各州抽取了一部分ACR,并聘请了人群工作者从网络图像中双推出中文名. 为了量化在翻译中丢失的信息,我们调整了8维名称框架并创建了"名Frames"数据集. 本数据集收录了整个884个ACR的英文和中文名称的说明.

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Collection
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据收集

blocks.en: From 2023-07-13 to 2023-07-15, we collected U.S. restaurants categorized as ‘‘Chinese restaurant’’ using Outscrapper 2 2 2 https://outscraper.com/google-maps-api/ , which provides public Google Maps Places API information such as names, websites, locations, ratings, prices, and photos. We filtered out chain and fast food restaurants because their names repeat frequently (Appendix A.1.1 ), yielding 31,548 unique ACRs. We then used stratified sampling by state to select 3,172 ACRs: 10% from states with more than 400 ACRs, 40 restaurants from states with 40–400 ACRs, and all restaurants from states with fewer than 40 ACRs. Finally, we removed duplicate Chinese–English name pairs. See Appendix A.1 for the distribution. See the distribution of ACRs in Appendix A.1 .
blocks.zh: 使用Outscrapper 2 2 2 https://outscraper.com/google-maps-apis-api/, 提供公共Google地图 Places API信息, 如姓名、网站、地点、收视率、价格和相片。 我们过滤出连锁餐厅和快餐餐厅,因为它们的名字经常重复(附录A.1.1),产生了31 548个独特的ACR。 然后,我们用按州分级的抽样来选择3,172个ACR:10%来自拥有400个ACR以上的州,40个餐厅来自拥有40至400个ACR的州,以及所有来自拥有不到40个ACR的州。 最后,我们删除了重复的中文-英文名配对. 分发情况见附录A.1。 见附录A.1所载ACR的分布情况。

blocks.en: 3.2 Chinese Name Transcription
blocks.zh: 3.2 中文名称译名

blocks.en: Google Maps API provides English names of the ACRs but not the Chinese names. To obtain accurate transcriptions of their Chinese names, we first obtained IRB exemption and hired two Chinese-speaking crowd workers to identify and transcribe the Chinese name of each restaurant in simplified Chinese characters by browsing its photos from Google Maps (see Figure 1 ). If there is any disagreement between two annotators, one of the authors reviewed the annotations to make a final decision. We observed a decent inter-rater agreement score 0.673 in Cohen’s Kappa. After transcribing the Chinese names of the 3,172 ACRs, we identified 1,722 ACRs with both English and Chinese names and 1,450 with only English names.
blocks.zh: Google Maps API提供ACR的英文名,但不提供中文名. 为了获得其中文名的准确的抄写,我们首先获得了IRB的豁免,并聘请了两名会讲中文的人群工作者,通过从Google Maps上浏览其照片(见图一),以简化的中文字符来识别并转录各餐厅的中文名. 如果两位注释员之间有任何分歧,一位作者审查了说明,以作出最后决定。 在科恩的Kappa, 在转录了3,172个ACR的中文名后,我们确定了1,722个ACR的英文名和中文名,1,450个只有英文名.

blocks.en: 3.3 Name Frame Design
blocks.zh: 3.3 名称框架设计

blocks.en: Chen (2018) proposed a few name frames to conduct qualitative analysis on meanings encoded in ACR English names. We adapted their framework and generalized these frames to both English and Chinese names. Table 1 shows the simplified frame definitions and selected examples. The complete codebook can be found in Appendix A.3 .
blocks.zh: Chen (2018)提出几个名字框架,对ACR英文名字所编码的含义进行定性分析. 我们调整了它们的框架,将这些框架概括为英文和中文两个名称。 表1列出了简化框架定义和选定的实例。 完整的编码本可参见附录A.3.

blocks.en: 3.4 Name Frame Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.4 名称框架注释

blocks.en: We sampled 884 ACRs for frame annotation. Each restaurant was annotated by three co-authors who are native Chinese speakers with professional English proficiency. We annotated the data in two rounds, discussing disagreements after each round to refine the frame definitions and annotations. As shown in Table 4 , inter-annotator agreement was high across the eight frames, with scores ranging from 0.78 to 0.935 for English names and 0.79 to 0.9 for Chinese names. To tune LLMs for labeling the remaining data, we randomly split the annotated data into 50% validation and 50% test sets for each language, removing duplicate names within each language.
blocks.zh: 我们抽取了884个ACR来做框架注释 每个餐厅都由三位共同撰稿人作注释,他们是讲英语专业的本地汉语人. 我们分两轮对数据作了说明,每轮之后讨论分歧,以完善框架定义和说明。 如表4所示,8个框架的注释者之间的协议很高,英文名字的分数从0.78到0.935,中文名字从0.79到0.9。 为了调用LLMS来标记所余数据,我们随机将附加说明的数据分解为每种语言的50%验证和50%的测试集,去掉每种语言的重复名称.

blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: First, we describe methods to detect name frames and compare their performance on NameFrames . These frame detection models were used to automate frame analysis and to determine the information gained or lost when comparing English and Chinese names. We utilize both frame-based Jaccard distance and embedding-based Cosine distance to quantify the semantic discrepancies between names. These distance scores were subsequently correlated with socio-contextual factors. Finally, we conducted and analyzed ten qualitative interviews to deepen our understanding of the Chinese immigrant integration into US society.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们描述了检测名称框架的方法,并比较它们在“命名Frames”上的性能。 这些帧检测模型被用于自动帧分析,并用于确定在比较英文和中文名称时获得或丢失的信息. 我们利用基于帧的Jaccard相距和嵌入相干相距来量化名称之间的语义差异. 这些距离分数随后与社会-文字因素相关. 最后,我们进行并分析了十次定性访谈,以加深我们对中国移民融入美国社会的理解。

blocks.en: 4.1 Name Frame Detection
blocks.zh: 4.1 名称框架检测

blocks.en: The task of name frame detection is defined in the following manner: Given a specific name denoted as N N , our target is to identify if each specific frame f i f_{i} within the set F F of all possible frames is encoded in the name N N .
blocks.zh: 名称框架检测任务的定义如下: 由于一个具体名称表示为 N N ,我们的目标是确定所有可能框架的F F 组内每个具体框架f i f _{i}是否在名称N N 中编码。

blocks.en: We built rule-based and prompt-based methods to detect name frames from ACR English and Chinese names. To establish a strong baseline, we first developed a rule-based model (“Expert Rules” in Table 2 ) based on lexicons and/or heuristics for each name frame respectively. Details about the lexicon-based approach are discussed in Appendix B.1 . Afterwards, we experimented with GPT-5.5 3 3 3 https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-5-5/ , Qianwen ( qwen3.7-max ) 4 4 4 https://openrouter.ai/qwen/qwen3.7-max , Kimi ( kimi-k2.6 ) 5 5 5 https://huggingface.co/moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6 , and Claude Sonnet 4.6 ( claude-sonnet-4.6 ) 6 6 6 https://openrouter.ai/anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6 given that they are among the state-of-the-art multilingual LLMs. We do not include fine-tuned language models such as RoBERTa Liu et al. (2019b) as baselines because they do not perform well on our small dataset where some labels are too sparse for effective fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 我们建立了基于规则的即时方法,从ACR英文和中文名称中检测出名称框架. 为了确定一个强有力的基准,我们首先根据每个名称框架的词汇和(或)弹性分别制定了基于规则的模型(“表2中的专家规则”)。 关于以词汇为基础的方法的详细情况,见附录B.1。 随后,我们试用了GPT-5.5 3 3 3 https://openai.com/index/introductioning-gpt-5-5-5. 5 ; Qianwen (qwen3.7-max) 4 4 4 https://openrouter.ai/qwen/qwen3.7-max; Kimi (kimi-k2.6) 5 5 5 https://huggingface.co/moonshortai/Kimi-K2.6; Claude Sonnet 4.6 (claude-sonnet 4.6) 6 6 6 https://openrouter.ai/harmic/claude-sonnet-4.6 5 5 5 5 5 5 5 5 https://huggingface.com/moonshtai/Clode-sonnet. 因为他们是最先进的多语言法学硕士。 我们没有将罗贝塔·刘等(2019年b)等微调语言模型作为基线,因为这些模型在我们的小数据集上表现不佳,因为有些标签太少,无法进行有效微调。

blocks.en: We experimented with three prompting strategies: (1) name + definition (“zero-shot”), (2) name + definition + rules + examples (“few-shot”). The first strategy is zero-shot , which prompts LLMs to predict if the restaurant name encodes a certain frame given its name and definition. The second strategy few-shot , which aims to improve the strategy (1) by providing a few examples or rules of the target frame along with its name and definition. Strategy (2) provides the frame name, definition, expert-curated rules, and common types of examples to LLMs in a highly similar format as the codebook (see Appendix A.3 ). The format of these two prompt variants are discussed in the Appendix B.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们试验了三种提示策略:(1) 名称+定义 ("零射"),(2) 名称+定义 + 规则 + 实例 ("few-shot"). 第一个策略是零镜头(0-shot),它促使LLMs预测餐厅名称是否根据名称和定义编码了某个帧. 第二项战略旨在改进战略(1),提供几个目标框架的例子或规则及其名称和定义。 战略(2)提供了框架名称、定义、专家确定的规则,以及LLMS的常见例子类型,其格式与编码本非常相类似(见附录A.3)。 附录B.2讨论了这两种即时变体的格式。

blocks.en: For model-based name-frame labeling, we used comparable settings across GPT-5.5, Qwen3.7-Max, Kimi K2.6, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 where supported: seed 42, reasoning disabled, batches of 20 labels per request, and an 800-token output cap. We set temperature to 0.0 for Qwen3.7-Max, Kimi K2.6, and Claude Sonnet 4.6; GPT-5.5 did not support user-specified temperature for this endpoint, so we relied on seed 42 for determinism.
blocks.zh: 对于基于模型的名称框架标签,我们使用了跨GPT-5.5、Qune3.7-Max、Kimi K2.6和Claude Sonnet4.6的可比较设置,支持这些设置:种子42、推理被禁用、批次每请求20个标签,以及一个800个托肯输出盖。 我们把Qwen3.7-Max,Kimi K2.6,和克洛德·索内特 4.6的温度设定为0.0;GPT-5.5不支持这个端点的用户指定温度,因此我们依靠42号种子来决定.

Overall, no single model dominates across all frames, but the newer LLMs generally outperform Expert Rules. GPT-5.5 achieves the highest average weighted F1 in both Chinese and English labeling, so we use it to label the remaining data.
blocks.zh: 在表2中,由于空间限制,我们显示每个模型的最佳结果,附录B.3中则显示全部迅速设定结果。 总体而言,没有单一模式在所有框架中占据主导地位,但较新的LLMS一般优于专家规则。 GPT-5.5在中英文标签中实现了最高平均加权F1,因此我们用它来给所余数据作标签.

blocks.en: 4.2 Measuring Name Discrepancies
blocks.zh: 4.2 计量名称差异

blocks.en: We developed two different metrics to quantify discrepancies between the Chinese and English names. The first metric is based on name frames, which aims to capture typical meanings such as culture and interesting syntactic forms such as creativity . The second embedding-based metric is a standard NLP method to quantify semantic differences. In our study, we first translates the Chinese name to English and measures the embedding distance between translated and original English names. These two metrics are meant to capture slightly different aspects of linguistic discrepancies in names.
blocks.zh: 我们制定了两个不同的度量衡,以量化中文和英文名称之间的差异。 第一个衡量标准基于名称框架,其目的是捕捉文化等典型意义和创造性等有趣的综合形式。 第二个基于嵌入的度量衡是将语义差异量化的标准NLP方法. 在我们的研究中,我们首先将中文名译为英文并测量了被译为英文名和原始英文名之间的嵌入距离. 这两个衡量标准旨在捕捉名称中语言差异的略为不同的方面.

blocks.en: Alternatively, we measure semantic difference using name embeddings. We translate each Chinese restaurant name into English as literally as possible, then compute the distance between the translated Chinese name and the observed English name. Because literal name translation differs from standard machine translation, we evaluated Google Cloud Translation API Basic V2 7 7 7 https://cloud.google.com/translate , GPT-5.5, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 against two human literal-translation references for 99 restaurants. Claude Sonnet 4.6 achieved the strongest average embedding similarity and BERTScore, so we use its translations in the main analysis; full translation results are reported in Appendix B.5 . We then use all-mpnet-base-v2 8 8 8 https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 to compute embedding-based semantic distance.

blocks.en: 4.2.3 Interview with ACR Owners
blocks.zh: 4.2.3 与ACR业主的面谈

blocks.en: To understand how ACR owners create Mandarin and English names, we interviewed ten ACR owners in Massachusetts about factors influencing naming decisions like customer groups and location, and how the restaurant reflects the owner’s heritage and identity. We analyzed the interviews using affinity diagramming Lucero (2015) to identify key naming themes. Additional interview procedures are in Appendix C.1 , and a fuller summary of results is in Appendix C.3 .

blocks.en: 5 Analysis & Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 分析和讨论

blocks.en: We are interested in answering the following research questions (RQs): RQ1 : are there systematic discrepancies in naming practices in ACRs? RQ2 : what socio-contextual factors impact the ACR naming process? RQ3 : do ACR owners deliberately adjust the parallel names to their audiences?
blocks.zh: 我们有兴趣回答以下研究问题(RQs): RQ1:ACR中命名做法是否有系统性的差异? RQ2:哪些社会-文字因素影响ACR命名过程?. RQ3:ACR所有者是否有意调整平行名称给观众?

blocks.en: 5.1 Discrepancies in Parallel Names
blocks.zh: 5.1 平行名称的差异

blocks.en: By applying the best frame detection models to the 1,722 ACRs with both Chinese and English names, we show the distribution of naming frames in Figure 2 , using GPT5.5 labels with human overrides when available. The clearest pattern is that English names more often emphasize Location and Specialty , while Chinese names more often emphasize Positivity . Chinese names also show slightly higher counts for Culture and Ambiance , while Creativity remains rare in both languages. These patterns suggest that English-facing names tend to foreground legible market information, such as geographic cues and cuisine type, whereas Chinese names more often preserve auspicious, evaluative, or culturally meaningful content.
blocks.zh: 通过对1,722个既有中文名字又有英文名字的ACR应用最佳帧检测模型,我们在图2中显示命名帧的分布,在可用时使用GPT5.5标签并带有人类的覆盖. 最清楚的规律是,英文名称更经常地强调"位置"和"特有",而中文名称更经常地强调"可能性". 中文名称也显示文化与安比昂斯(Ambiance)的分数略高, 这些模式表明,英文名称往往会预示可识别的市场信息,如地理提示和烹饪类型,而中文名称则更经常地保留吉祥、评价或文化上有意义的内容。

blocks.en: 5.2 Location
blocks.zh: 5.2 地点

blocks.en: Location is an important factor shaping naming practices. We quantify semantic differences between parallel Chinese and English names using both frame-based Jaccard distance and embedding-based cosine distance. As shown in Figure 3(a) , ANOVA tests show significant location differences for both metrics. Post-hoc Tukey HSD tests indicate that urban ACRs have significantly more divergent parallel names than rural ACRs for both metrics, while the urban–suburban and rural–suburban differences are not statistically significant. We conjecture that this pattern reflects the different audience structures of urban restaurant markets: in urban areas, where Chinese-speaking customers are more concentrated, ACRs may have stronger incentives to preserve distinctive Chinese-facing names while using more familiar English-facing names for broader local audiences.

The interview study provides a concrete example of the patterns shown in Figure 3(a) .
In urban areas such as Boston’s Chinatown, where ACRs are abundant, owners face intense competition and strive to distinguish their establishments.
For instance, R7 shared that a restaurant in Chinatown has to be “unique to stand out so that they can have business. There is a lot of competition for the same type of food, and other restaurants have been open for longer.” R7 identified a type of Chinese food that was not being sold in Chinatown and incorporated distinctive elements of his cuisine into both the Mandarin and English names to attract patrons.
Conversely, in rural and suburban settings with fewer ACRs, restaurant owners may prioritize personal connections and autonomy over differentiation.
R9 decided to open a restaurant in a rural town to “escape Chinatown.” He and his partner picked their current location because it is “adventurous” , and they wanted to “start a new life with more freedom.” The newfound freedom is reflected in R9’s choice of naming the restaurant in memory of his daughter and deciding not to create a Mandarin name.

blocks.en: 5.3 Chinese Ethnic Percentage
blocks.zh: 5.3 中国民族百分比

blocks.en: We also test whether naming practices vary with local Chinese population share. Using 2022 ACS county-level estimates from NHGIS 9 9 9 https://www.nhgis.org/data , we divide counties into high- and low-Chinese-percent groups based on the sample median. As shown in Figure 3(b) , ACRs in high-Chinese-percent counties show greater frame-based name divergence than those in low-Chinese-percent counties (Jaccard distance: 0.594 vs. 0.539; Welch’s p = 0.005 p=0.005 ). However, the continuous Pearson correlation with Chinese percentage is not statistically significant, and embedding-based distance shows almost no group difference (0.517 vs. 0.514; p = 0.800 p=0.800 ). These results suggest that Chinese population share is associated more clearly with categorical naming-frame divergence than with overall embedding distance. One interpretation is that ACR owners in areas with larger Chinese communities may be more comfortable using distinctive Chinese-facing naming frames while keeping English-facing names legible to broader local audiences.
blocks.zh: 我们还检验命名做法是否与中国当地人口的比例不同。 使用来自NHGIS 9 9 9 https://www.nhgis.org/data的2022 ACS县级估算,我们根据样本中位数将县划分为高中低中百分率组. 如图3(b)所示,高中分县的ACR比低中分县的框名差异更大 (Jaccard距离:0.594对0.539;Welch's p = 0.005 p = 0.005) 然而,与中国百分比的连续皮尔逊相关性在统计学上并不显著,基于嵌入的距离显示几乎没有群体差异(0.517对0.514;p = 0.800 p = 0.800). 这些结果表明,中国人口的比例与绝对的命名框架差异有关,而不是与整体嵌入距离有关。 一种解释是,中国社区面积较大的地区的ACR所有者可能比较舒服地使用有特色的中文格式命名框,同时保持英文格式的名称能够被更广泛的当地受众辨识出.

blocks.en: The interviews show that owners strategically consider customer groups, especially age and cultural background, as their customers change over time. For example, R10 adapts food to a rural local population that is less than 1% Chinese, while R5 targets international Chinese students visiting Chinatown.
blocks.zh: 访谈显示,随着顾客随时间的变化,业主从战略上考虑顾客群体,特别是年龄和文化背景. 例如,R10对当地农村人口的粮食改造不足1%的华人,而R5针对的是访问唐人街的国际华人学生.

blocks.en: This customer awareness often shapes naming choices. Mandarin names help attract Chinese-speaking customers: R2, whose customers are about 50% Chinese, chose a Chinese name that signals regional dishes and noted that the mismatch between the Chinese and English names sparks curiosity among Chinese customers, who “want to investigate and try it.” English names, by contrast, are often chosen to be familiar and legible to American customers. R2 chose the English name first because the “name tells [American customers] it’s an Asian food.”
blocks.zh: 这种客户意识往往塑造出命名选择. 普通话名字有助于吸引会说中文的顾客: R2的顾客大约是50%的中国人, 相形之下,英文名字往往被选为美国顾客所熟悉并可以辨认. R2之所以选择英文名, “

blocks.en: 5.4 Opening Date
blocks.zh: 5.4 开幕日期

blocks.en:
We also investigate whether the opening date is associated with the naming practice. Since it is difficult to obtain the opening date of these restaurants, we use the date from the earliest review for each restaurant on Google Maps to approximate the opening date. To make the periods as comparable as possible, we divide the dates into three equal-month periods: the first period “2004-01 to 2010-08”, the second period “2010-09 to 2017-04”, and the third period “2017-05 to 2023-12”. We find that ACRs in the third period have the highest mean divergence under both Jaccard and Cosine distance. However, the updated ANOVA results are significant only for Cosine distance, and the post-hoc Tukey HSD tests do not show significant pairwise differences between periods.
To avoid potential bias introduced by manually selecting time intervals, we directly calculated the Pearson correlation using “days since opening” to examine whether a temporal trend exists. We found a negative correlation between opening time and Cosine distance using Pearson correlation ( r ⁡ ( 1703 ) = − .062 , p = .010 r(1703)=-.062,p=.010 ), suggesting that newer restaurants tend to have slightly more divergent parallel names; the corresponding Jaccard-distance association is not statistically significant. Our hypothesis is that in recent years ACR owners may have become more comfortable marking their Chinese identity using distinctive Chinese names while keeping familiar English names for local customers, though the updated temporal evidence is weaker than before.
blocks.zh:
我们还调查开通日期是否与命名做法有关. 由于很难获得这些餐厅的开业日期,我们用谷歌地图上每个餐厅最早审查的日期来大致确定开业日期. 为了使这些时期尽可能具有可比性,我们将日期分为三个等月:第一个时期“2004-01至2010-08”,第二个时期“2010-09至2017-04”,第三个时期“2017-05至2023-12”。 我们发现第三期的ACR在Jaccard和Cosine相距下平均相差最大. 然而,更新的ANOVA结果仅对克辛相距来说是显著的,而后期的图克通HSD测试并未显示不同时期间有显著的对等差异.
为了避免人工选择时间间隔可能造成的偏差,我们直接用“开通以来的天数”来计算皮尔逊关系,以审查是否存在时间趋势。 我们利用皮尔逊的关联(r ⁡ (1703)=-.062,p =.010 r (1703)=-.062,p =.010)发现了开业时间和科辛距离之间的负相关关系,说明较新的餐馆往往有稍有相差的平行名称;相应的雅克卡尔-距离协会在统计学上并不重要. 我们的假设是,近年来ACR所有者可能更加舒适地用与众不同的中文名来标记他们的中国身份,同时为当地顾客保留熟悉的英文名,尽管更新的时间证据比以前更弱.

blocks.en: Though most interviewees opened restaurants before 2011, several examples suggest how opening period shaped naming decisions. R4 named a 2003 restaurant after a popular late-1990s movie featuring Chinese characters, explaining that “it is good to have a simple name to be more acceptable by customers.” R6, whose restaurant opened in 2010, chose an English name associated with a popular Chinese dish that was receiving media attention, which “made American customers curious.” In contrast, the two owners who opened restaurants after 2016 emphasized personal identity: R1 wanted the name to “be personal” by including her Chinese name, while R7 said he “does not care if other people like the name” when creating and copyrighting it.
blocks.zh: 虽然大多数受访者在2011年之前开餐馆, R4以1990年代后期流行的以中国人物为主角的电影命名了一家2003年的餐厅,他解释说,“有一个更简单的名字为顾客所接受是件好事。” R6, 其餐厅于2010年开业, 相比之下,2016年后开餐馆的两位老板强调个人身份:R1希望这个名字包含她的中文名来"个人",而R7则表示他在创作和版权时"不在乎其他人喜欢这个名字".

blocks.en: Owners also reflected on broader changes in ACRs. R3 confirms the pattern shown in Figure 3(c) , sharing that “many new restaurants with creative names are opening. Many owners are now international students or joint ventures.” , though many also “opened and closed quickly.” R10 observed that “more authentic Chinese food is getting here,” while R8 argued that “Chinatowns are dying and spreading to different communities,” linking this diffusion to greater confidence, English fluency, and integration into U.S. society.
blocks.zh: 所有人还反思了ACR的更广泛变化。 R3证实了图3(c)所示模式,认为“许多有创意的新餐馆正在开业。 许多业主现在都是国际学生或合资企业, R10指出,“更真实的中国食品正在到来,”而R8则认为“中国城镇正在消亡并蔓延到不同的社区,”将这种传播与更大的信心、英语流利和融入美国社会联系起来。

blocks.en: 5.5 Effect size of socio-contextual factors
blocks.zh: 5.5 社会-文字因素的影响大小

blocks.en:
To evaluate how much socio-contextual factors influence naming discrepancy, we performed multivariate regression followed by non-linear robustness checks (Appendix E ). The multivariate regression results show that only rural location ( β = − .168 , p = .014 \beta=-.168,p=.014 ) for Jaccard distance and opening date ( β = − .018 , p = .006 \beta=-.018,p=.006 ) for Cosine distance yielded statistically significant results. For both naming discrepancy measurements, the multivariate regression models showed low explanatory power ( R 2 < 0.008 R^{2}<0.008 ). Random Forest regressor robustness check yielded non-positive explanatory power, suggesting no meaningful non-linear relationships are left undetected.
We offer the following reflections on these experiment results. First, we acknowledge a pronounced class imbalance in our dataset, where rural entries account for only 2% of the sample compared to 91% for urban entries. However, this class imbalance is not caused by our sampling procedure, but by the data incompleteness in the demographic data source. Furthermore, the low explanatory power of our regression models indicates that restaurant naming cannot be adequately explained by a few macro-level factors; rather, owners’ choices are driven by more complex, idiosyncratic decision-making processes.
blocks.zh:
为了评价社会-文字因素影响命名差异的程度,我们进行了多变量回归,然后进行了非线性强性检查(附录E . 多变回归结果显示,只有Jaccard距离和开通日期(β=-0.018,p=-.018,p=-.006)Cosine距离的农村位置(β=-.168,p=-.006)得出了统计上的重大结果. 对于两个命名差异的测量,多变量回归模型都显示出较低的解释力(R 2 < 0.008 R^{2}<0.008 ) 。 随机森林退缩强度检查产生了非正向解释力,表明没有有意义的非线性关系未被发现。
我们对这些实验结果提出以下思考。 首先,我们承认我们数据集中存在明显的阶级不平衡,农村条目只占抽样的2%,而城市条目占91%。 然而,这种阶级不平衡并非由我们的抽样程序所造成,而是由人口数据来源的数据不完整所造成。 此外,我们回归模式解释力低表明,餐馆的命名不能由几个宏观因素充分解释;相反,业主的选择是由更为复杂和典型的决策过程所驱动的。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In conclusion, our paper studies cultural assimilation through discrepancies between parallel English and Chinese names of ACRs. We adapt an eight-dimensional name-frame schema and create the NameFrames dataset on 884 pairs of ACR names. Using GPT-5.5 labels with human overrides, we find that English names more often emphasize Location and Specialty , while Chinese names more often emphasize Positivity , and to a lesser extent Culture and Ambiance . Applying the labels to the 1,722 ACRs with both English and Chinese names, we show that these patterns extend beyond the annotated sample. These results suggest that English-facing names foreground legible market information, whereas Chinese-facing names preserve more auspicious and culturally meaningful content.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们的文件研究了通过平行的英文和中文名称之间的差异进行文化同化的问题。 我们调整了一个八维名称框架计划 并在884对ACR名称上创建了NameFrames数据集. 使用GPT-5. 5 标签, 将标签应用于有英文和中文名称的1,722个ACR,我们显示,这些图案超出了注解样本的范围. 这些结果表明,英文地名前景可辨识的市场信息,而中文地名则保留了更吉利和文化上有意义的内容。

blocks.en: We further show that name divergence is associated with context, though the strength of the relationship depends on the distance metric. ACRs in urban areas show greater Chinese–English name divergence than rural restaurants, while suburban restaurants generally fall between the two. Counties with higher Chinese population share show larger frame-based differences, but not consistently larger embedding-based differences. Opening-date analyses also suggest that more recently opened restaurants tend to exhibit greater embedding-based divergence, while frame-based results are weaker. Together, these findings suggest that ACR naming practices reflect both market-facing adaptation and the preservation of culturally meaningful Chinese-facing identities, with divergence shaped by local market, ethnic, and temporal context. We complement the computational analysis with ten qualitative interviews with ACR owners to better understand the motivations, audience considerations, and lived experiences behind these naming practices.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步表明,名称差异与上下文有关,尽管关系的力量取决于距离度量. 城市地区的ACR显示中英文名差异大于农村餐厅,而郊区餐厅则一般在两者之间倒下. 中国人口份额较高的国家显示出较大的帧差异,但并非一贯较大的嵌入差异。 开业日期分析还表明,最近开业的餐馆往往显示出更大的嵌入式差异,而以框架为基础的结果则较弱。 这些调查结果都表明,ACR的命名做法既反映了市场化的适应,也反映了文化上有意义的中国化特征的保存,地方市场、族裔和时间背景造成了分歧。 我们用对ACR所有者的十次定性访谈来补充计算分析,以更好地理解这些命名做法背后的动机,受众考虑和生动的经验.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Restaurant names are one public-facing artifact among many, and they are shaped by forces that have little to do with cultural orientation: family history, prior tenants and inherited signage, landlord or municipal sign constraints, trademark availability, delivery-platform display conventions, and simple inertia after ownership changes. A divergent name pair is therefore evidence of a naming practice , not a measurement of an owner’s identity or degree of assimilation, and we caution against reading our aggregate patterns as individual-level inferences.
blocks.zh: 餐厅名称是众多公共名胜之一,其形状与文化取向几乎没有多大关系:家庭历史、前房客和继承的标志、房东或市政标志限制、商标可用性、交付平台展示惯例、所有权变更后简单的惯性。 因此,不同的名称组合是命名做法的证据,而不是对所有人身份或同化程度的衡量,我们告诫不要将我们的总体模式视为个人层面的推论。

blocks.en: Of the 3,172 sampled ACRs, we recovered Chinese names for 1,722. The remaining 1,450 include both restaurants that genuinely have no Chinese name and restaurants whose Chinese signage was simply not visible in available Google Maps photos, Street View imagery, or websites. These two cases are systematically confounded with the very covariates we study: urban restaurants and those in high-Chinese-share counties are more likely to be photographed, to have interior menu photos, and to display Chinese signage prominently. Our analyses condition on successful recovery, so location and ethnic-share effects may be partly attributable to differential visibility rather than differential naming.
blocks.zh: 在被抽取的3,172个ACR中,我们以1,722个回收了中文名. 其余的1,450家包括真正没有中文名的餐厅和在现有的Google地图照片、街景图像或网站中根本看不到中文标志的餐厅。 这两个案例与我们所研究的非常相似之处是系统性地混淆不清的:城市餐馆和高中分县的餐馆更容易被拍照,有内部菜单相片,以及突出显示中国的标志. 我们的分析是以成功的恢复为条件的,因此,地点和族裔分享的影响可以部分归因于不同的能见度,而不是不同的命名。

blocks.en: We instructed annotators to transcribe into simplified characters. Many ACRs, particularly those founded by Cantonese- and Toisanese-speaking immigrants, use traditional characters, and some romanize according to Cantonese rather than Mandarin. Normalizing to simplified Mandarin erases orthographic and dialectal information that is itself a marker of migration cohort and regional origin, and our Romanization frame is defined in ways that implicitly privilege Mandarin pinyin.
blocks.zh: 我们指示了注解员将简化字符转换成简化字符。 许多ACR,尤其是由广东语和通语移民所创办的ACR,使用传统字符,有的按照广东语而不是普通话来罗马化. 普通话的通俗化抹去正文和方言信息,这些信息本身就是移民群体和地区起源的标志,我们的罗马化框架被用暗地里特权于普通话平宁的方式定义。

blocks.en:
Our eight frames are adapted from a schema developed qualitatively on 423 English names in a single county, then generalized to Chinese. The resulting categories may not carve Chinese naming practice at its joints: conventions such as the 记suffix, register distinctions among 轩/ 楼/ 阁/ 坊, and numerological auspiciousness
are absorbed into broad frames rather than modeled directly. Labels are binary and unweighted, so a name that gestures faintly at Culture and one built entirely around a cultural symbol are treated identically. Annotation was performed by co-authors who were not blind to the study hypotheses, which raises the possibility of hypothesis-consistent labeling despite high inter-annotator agreement.
blocks.zh:
我们的8个框架是从一个县的423个英文名称上 开发出来的,然后被通俗化为中文。 由此产生的类别可能不会在其关节上刻出中国的取名惯例:公约,如: 第 440 后缀,记录了 107/ 138/ 阁/ 坊 和数字吉祥
被吸收到宽框中,而不是直接建模。 标签是二进制和不加权的,因此一个在文化上略微表态的名字,以及一个完全围绕一个文化符号而建的名字,都得到了同样的对待. 注释是由不盲从研究假设的同名作者进行的,这就使得尽管有高度的同名注释者之间的一致意见,仍有可能提出符合假设的标签.

blocks.en: Jaccard distance over eight binary frames is coarse and takes only a small number of discrete values, and the label spaces are asymmetric: Romanization is undefined for Chinese names, which mechanically inflates JD for any English name carrying that frame. Cosine distance is computed after a translation step, so translation error propagates directly into the measure; all-mpnet-base-v2 is an English-only encoder trained on general text and is not well calibrated for very short proper-noun strings. The two metrics disagree in several analyses (notably Chinese population share), and we report both rather than adjudicating between them, but this also means our conclusions are metric-dependent.
blocks.zh: 8个二进制框上的Jaccard距离粗糙,只取少量离散值,标签空格不对称: 罗曼化对于中文名字是没有定义的,机械地夸大了JD对于任何带有这个框架的英文名字. 余弦相距在翻译步骤后被计算出,因此翻译错误会直接传播到测量中;All-mpnet-base-v2是只使用英语的编码器,训练有通俗文字,对于很短的正名字符串没有很好的校正. 两种衡量标准在几种分析中存在分歧(尤其是中国人口比例),我们既报告两者,又报告二者之间的判断,但这也意味着我们的结论取决于衡量。

blocks.en: All socio-contextual analyses are observational. County-level ACS estimates are aggregates, so associations with Chinese population share are subject to the ecological fallacy: we do not observe the composition of any restaurant’s actual customer base. Median-splitting a continuous covariate discards information and can manufacture group differences that the continuous test does not support, which is precisely the pattern we observe. We test three socio-contextual factors under two metrics without correcting for multiple comparisons, so borderline results should be treated as exploratory.
blocks.zh: 所有的社会文字分析都是观察性的. 县级ACS估算为总量,因此与中国人口份额的关联受到生态谬论的影响:我们不观察任何餐厅实际客户基础的构成. 中分一个连续的同变量会丢弃信息,并且可以制造连续测试不支持的组分差异,这正是我们观察到的模式. 我们用两个衡量标准来测试三个社会-文字因素,而不纠正多重比较,所以分界线的结果应该作为探索性的结果来对待.

blocks.en: We approximate opening date by the earliest Google Maps review, which systematically compresses the histories of older restaurants (Google Maps reviews are sparse before the early 2010s) and misdates restaurants that rebranded, changed ownership, or relocated. Our sample also contains only restaurants operating at collection time, so any temporal trend confounds cohort effects with differential survival—and one of our own interviewees observed that many newer, creatively named restaurants “opened and closed quickly.”
blocks.zh: 我们以最早的Google Maps评论为开业日期, 系统地压缩了老餐馆的历史(Google Maps评论在2010年代初期之前是稀有的), 我们的样本中也只包含在收集时间开业的餐馆,因此任何时间趋势都会把群体效应混为一谈——我们自己的一位受访者观察到,许多更新颖,有创意的餐馆“迅速开业并关闭了”。 “

blocks.en: Our qualitative component comprises ten owners in Massachusetts, eight of them urban, six from Fuzhou. Recruitment by walk-in and cold call selects for owners with time and willingness to talk. Because most participants declined recording, our data are English-language notes taken in real time during Mandarin-language interviews, so we have no verbatim transcripts; quoted material reflects a note-taker’s contemporaneous rendering rather than the participant’s exact words. Themes were identified by authors already familiar with the computational findings.
blocks.zh: 我们的质量部分包括马萨诸塞州的10个业主,其中8个来自城市,6个来自福州. 招生通过走入和冷电话选择有时间和愿意交谈的业主. 由于大多数参与者拒绝录制,我们的数据是在普通话访谈中实时录取的英语笔记,因此我们没有逐字记录;所引用的材料反映了一名笔记员当时的渲染,而不是参与者确切的文字。 已经熟悉计算结果的作者确定了主题。

blocks.en: Frame detection and translation depend on closed, versioned commercial models accessed through APIs. These endpoints are not stable over time, which limits exact reproducibility even with fixed seeds, and we cannot rule out that widely circulated ACR names or prior work on this topic appeared in pretraining data. LLMs also encode culturally situated priors about what counts as “cultural,” “creative,” or market-legible, and those priors are plausibly Western-centric in ways that align with—rather than independently test—our hypotheses. We therefore treat model outputs as structured approximations validated against human labels on a limited sample, not as ground truth.
blocks.zh: 框架检测和翻译依赖于通过API访问的已关闭,已版本的商业模型. 随着时间的推移,这些终点并不稳定,这限制了精确的再生产,即使有固定的种子,我们也不能排除广泛流传的ACR名称或之前关于这一主题的工作出现在预训数据中。 LLMS还就什么是 " 文化 " 、 " 创造 " 或 " 市场可理解性 " ,在文化上对前科进行编码,这些前科以西方为中心,与我们的假设相一致,而不是独立检验。 因此,我们把模型输出作为结构化的近似值,在有限的样本中根据人类的标签加以验证,而不是作为地面真理。

blocks.en: We study one diaspora, in one country, at one moment. “Chinese” is used throughout as an administrative convenience that flattens Cantonese, Fujianese, Taiwanese, Sichuanese, Hui, and Southeast Asian Chinese communities with quite different migration histories and naming conventions. We make no claims about other immigrant cuisines or about ACRs outside the United States.
blocks.zh: 我们研究一个散居国外的国家,在一个时刻。 " 华人 " 一直被用作一种行政便利,使广东、福建、台湾、四川、回族和东南亚华人社区在移徙历史和命名公约上大相径庭。 我们没有声称其他移民 菜肴或ACR在美国境外。

blocks.en: Our demographic data were sourced from IPUMS NHGIS. However, due to missing data in certain rural areas, we had to drop incomplete records during multivariate regression for effect size analysis. While this ensured complete feature coverage, it introduced class imbalance that potentially impacted data analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们的人口数据来自议会联盟国家地理信息系统。 然而,由于某些农村地区缺少数据,我们不得不在进行效应大小分析的多变量回归过程中放弃不完整的记录。 虽然这确保了完全的特征覆盖,但它引入了可能影响到数据分析的类别不平衡。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Both the transcription task and the owner interviews were reviewed by our institution’s IRB and received exempt determination). Interviews were conducted in Mandarin; participants received a verbal description of the study’s purpose and data handling and gave verbal informed consent before beginning. Most participants declined audio recording, and we honored this by taking written notes only. Participation was voluntary and participants could decline any question or withdraw at any point.
blocks.zh: 校对:Soup 访谈用普通话进行;与会者得到关于研究目的和数据处理的口头说明,并在开始前得到口头知情同意。 多数与会者拒绝录音,我们仅作书面笔记,以此为荣。 参与是自愿的,与会者可随时拒绝任何问题或退出。

blocks.en: Transcription was performed by Prolific workers who self-identified as first-language Chinese speakers. Across the task, workers logged approximately 67 hours. We paid an effective rate of 15 dollars/hour, above the state minimum wage and above Prolific’s recommended floor. Surveys were piloted to calibrate time estimates, and we did not reject submissions on the basis of disagreement between the two independent annotators.
blocks.zh: 译名由自认为第一语言汉语使用者的普罗力克工人进行. 在整个任务期间,工人大约记录了67小时。 我们支付了15美元/小时的有效工资,高于州最低工资和Prolific建议的最低工资。 测试调查是为了校正时间估计,我们没有因为两个独立注释者之间的分歧而拒绝提交。

blocks.en: Restaurants are public commercial entities and their names and locations are publicly listed, so we treat name and location data as public record. Owners, however, are individuals, and small-business owners are readily re-identifiable from a combination of city, opening year, and cuisine. We refer to interviewees only as R1–R10, do not report restaurant names, exact locations, or the names of family members, and paraphrase or omit details from the interviews that would narrow identification to a single establishment—including several personal and family circumstances that participants shared. Some quoted material remains distinctive despite these steps; we retained it only where participants indicated they were comfortable with the detail being reported.
blocks.zh: 餐馆是公共商业实体,其名称和地点被公开列出,因此我们将名称和地点数据视为公共记录. 然而,业主是个人,小企业业主很容易从城市、开业年份和菜肴的组合中重新识别。 我们只把受访者称为R1-R10, 不报告餐厅名称、确切地点或家庭成员姓名, 并且从访谈中转写或省略细节, 尽管采取了这些步骤,但所引述的一些材料仍然与众不同;我们只保留这些材料,因为与会者表示对报告的细节感到满意。

blocks.en: We release the NameFrames annotations—parallel name pairs with frame labels—together with our codebook, prompts, and analysis code, to support replication. We do not redistribute raw scraped Google Maps records, review text, photographs, or owner-associated metadata, both to respect platform terms of service and because aggregated business records are more easily repurposed for commercial targeting than the derived annotations we need for replication. No interview notes are released.
blocks.zh: 我们发布“Frames”说明,即带有框架标签的平行名称配对,连同我们的代码簿、提示和分析代码,支持复制。 我们不会重新分配原始的被刮去的Google地图记录、审查文本、照片或所有者关联的元数据,既是为了尊重平台服务条款,也因为汇总商业记录比我们需要复制的衍生说明更容易重新用于商业目标。 不发布采访笔记.

blocks.en: “Cultural assimilation” is a contested construct with a history of being used normatively to rank groups by their proximity to a dominant culture. Our name-distance measures are descriptive: a larger distance indicates that two names encode different meanings, not that an owner is less integrated, less authentic, or more foreign. We have tried to write against a reading in which divergence scores become an assimilation index applied to ethnic communities. Relatedly, frames such as Culture and Romanization risk reproducing an exoticizing gaze if read as markers of foreignness rather than as descriptive categories of naming practice.
blocks.zh: “文化同化”是一种有争议的概念,其历史是,通过接近主导文化,在规范上用于对群体进行排序。 我们的名称-距离测量是描述性的:更大的距离表示两个名称编码不同的含义,而不是说一个所有者集成程度更低,真实性更差,或者更外相. 我们曾试图反对把分歧分数变成适用于族裔社区的同化指数的解读。 与此相关的是,文化和罗马化等框架如果被读作外国的标志,而不是命名做法的描述性类别,则有可能产生异地的目光。

blocks.en: Aggregated, geolocated data about ethnic businesses can be repurposed for targeting—commercially, in the form of marketing or acquisition pressure, and in worse cases as input to harassment or discrimination. Anti-Asian harassment of restaurant businesses in the U.S. has been documented and recent. This informed our decision to release annotations rather than a geolocated business registry, and we encourage anyone extending this work to weigh the same tradeoff.
blocks.zh: 有关种族企业的地理分布的汇总数据可重新用于针对目标——在商业上采取营销或收购压力的形式,在更糟糕的情况下作为骚扰或歧视的投入。 反亚洲骚扰美国餐馆企业被有记载和最近. 这使我们决定发布说明,而不是地理分布的商业登记,我们鼓励任何人扩大这项工作,权衡同样的权衡。

blocks.en: The annotation team consists of native Chinese speakers with professional English proficiency, several of whom are themselves immigrants to the United States; the interviews were conducted by Mandarin-speaking members of the team. This shared background aided rapport and interpretation of culturally specific names, and it also means our intuitions about what is “auspicious,” “creative,” or “market-legible” are embedded in the codebook rather than external to it.
blocks.zh: 笔记组由具有专业英语熟练程度的本地汉语使用者组成,其中数人本身就是移民到美国;面试由团队中讲普通话的成员进行. 这种共同的背景有助于联系和解释文化上的具体名称,这也意味着我们对“可疑的”、“创造性的”或“可市场理解的”的直觉已嵌入法典,而不是其外部。

blocks.en: Here are the specific changes we have made to Chen (2018) ’s 9 name frames including (1) Personal Names , (2) Speciality , (3) Superlatives and Other Positive Modifiers , (4) Cultural Association , (5) Place Names , (6) Ambiance , (7) Others , (8) Transliterated Hanzi , (9) Express Takeout . First, we renamed (3) to Positivity , (4) to Culture , (5) to Location , and (8) to Romanization for simplicity in language. Second, we added a rule to include intimacy words related to family or relationship to the Ambiance frame, since we found that many ACRs like to use these words during our annotation. Third, we replaced the Others frame with a more specific Creativity frame and extended its definition to names with creative puns such as “Wok N’ Roll”. Fourth, we removed (9) in our analysis because the names of express ACRs tend to be highly repetitive and we excluded them in our analysis.
blocks.zh: 以下是我们对Chen (2018)的9个取名框所作的具体修改,包括 (1) 个人姓名, (2) 特长, (3) 超能和其他正向修改器, (4) 文化协会, (5) 地名, (6) Ambiance, (7) 其他, (8) 转写汉兹, (9) 特快外卖. 首先,我们把(3)改名为 " 可能性 " ,(4)改名为 " 文化 " ,(5)改名为 " 位置 " ,(8)改名为 " 罗马化 " ,以简化语言。 其次,我们增加了一条规则,列入与家庭或与Ambiance框架的关系相关的亲密词,因为我们发现许多ACR喜欢在我们注释时使用这些词. 第三,我们用一个更具体的创意框架取代了其他框架,并将其定义扩展至带有 " Wok N ' Roll " 等创造性动词的名称。 第四,我们在分析中删除了(9)个,因为快递ACR的名字往往非常重复,我们在分析中将其排除在外。

• Personal names : usually, but not necessarily, surnames or first names.
Here are some common examples: – Surnames with a possessive: Qing’s Kitchen , Hoy’s Wok , P.F. Chang’s China Bistro – Names without a possessive: China Lee , Hunan Mao , House of Louie , Mei Mei Dumplings – Surnames with a form of address or courtesy title: Mr Chow , Madame Wu’s Asian Bistro , MaMa Lu’s Dumpling House – Nicknames for family members or acquaintance: Ah-X , Liu Po – English names: Paul’s Kitchen , House of Benny , Bebe Fusion , Sam’s Chinese BBQ • Specialty : refers to certain food or dishes for which some restaurants are known for. Here are some common examples: – Names with special meat, seafood, and tofu: Duck Queen, Fishball House, Little Fat Sheep, Seafood Village, Tofu House – Names with BBQ and buffet: Sam’s Chinese BBQ, New Panda Buffet – Names of tea-drinking restaurants: Green Tea House, Boba Tea Station, Tea Time – Names with Dim Sum, Yum Cha, and Dim Sum dishes: Dim Sum Express, Yum Cha, Dumpling House, Tasty Bao, Egg Roll King – Names with hot pot and pot: Mongolian Hot Pot, China Pot King – Names with rice, noodles, congee: Noodle House, Rice N Noodles, The Congee, Porridge House – Names with religious meanings, vegetarian, and other cultures: China Halal, Happy Veggie Garden, Buddha’s Feast – Names with wok, snacks: China Wok, Rice Wok, Beijing Snacks • Superlatives and Other Positive Modifiers : refers to using superlatives and positive words in the names. Here are some examples: – Names with a superlative: China Best Express, China Great Buffet, Perfect Chinese Food, Elite, The Legendary, No. 1 Noodle House – Names with modifiers denoting superb taste: Delicious Food Corner, Tasty Wok Cuisine, Yummy Cafe, Luscious Dumplings, Chinese Gourmet Kitchen, Fresh China Kitchen – Names with gold, golden, silver, diamond, jade: Gold Medal Chinese Food, Golden China, Silver Palace, Shanghai Diamond Garden – Names with modifiers denoting good luck such as 8: 888 Fast Food, Lucky Seafood – Names with words that elicit positive expectations: Happy Family, House of Joy, Sunny Palace, Pleasure Ocean, Nice Time Cafe – Names with words that exude opulence: Grand Buffet, Feast from the East, Jumbo Chinese Fast Food – Names with royalty implications: China King, King Fu, Kingchops, Empress Pavilion, Empire Palace, Regent China Inn, Royal Spring, VIP, The Dynasty – Names with OK: OK Chinese Food – Names with red: Red House • Ambiance : refers to a kind of atmosphere which makes customers feel comfortable and enjoy the dining experience, or it often indicates family or friendship, or being homesick, which shortens the psychological distance between the restaurant and the patrons. Here are some common examples: – Names with the word “garden” that conveys a sense of tranquility and leisurely refinement: Garden and Ding’s, Mandarin Garden, Tasty Garden, New Garden – Name with the word “palace,” which suggests the image of imperial-style fine dining: China Palace, Rowland Palace, Silver Palace – Names that describe home-cooked meals in a more casual setting with words like “house,” “home,” “kitchen,” or “dining room”: House of Benny, Joy House, Moon House, New RJ Chinese Kitchen, Tao Chinese Kitchen, Chinese Kitchen, Spicy Home, Yang’s Dining Room – Names that evoke images of a simpler life or country living, like “hut”, “village”, “inn”, “bistro”: Boba Tea Hut, Green Village, Hunan Village, Bamboo Inn, Plum Tree Inn, Wok Inn, Madame Wu’s Asian Bistro, New Canton Bistro – Names that contain family members: Brother’s Chinese Restaurant, Uncle Tom’s Hot Pot, Grandma’s Pancake, Mama’s Kitchen – Names suggesting friendship: Friend’s house, Friends – Names that remind patrons of their hometown: Hometown Szechuan, Home Chinese Cafe • Creativity : refers to names that contain puns or words used creatively. Here are some examples: – ”wok with me” (sounds like “walk with me”), ”pho king good” (sounds like “fucking good”), ”rice to meet you” (sounds like “nice to meet you”), ”Wok N Talk” (’wok’ ryhmes with ’talk’), etc • Culture : refers to the Chinese, American, or other cultural symbols and references that appear in the names of restaurants. Here are some common examples: – Names that contain animals or mystical creatures native to China: Panda House, Dragon Garden, Phoenix tavern – Names that contain famous historical monuments: Great Wall, Forbidden City Restaurant, Golden Gate – Names that contain plants native to China: Bamboo Place, Plum Blossom – Names that contain famous historical or well-known figures: Jackie Chen’s Place – Names that contain the name of a specific Dynasty name: the Tang Dynasty, the Song Dynasty – Names that contain cultural artifacts: Lantern Garden, Silk House • Location : Names that refer to Asia, China, or specific regions in China or other places. Here are some common examples: – Names that refer to China, Asia, or other Asian countries: Chinese restaurant, Mandarin Garden, Asia Buffet, Chinese and Thai cuisine, Cathay House – Names that refer to a specific province or city: Xi’an Noodles, ShanDong Garden, Beijing House, Hong Kong restaurant, Shanghai and Tokyo, Canton Bistro – Names that contain the name of a town or street where the restaurant is located in: Wellesley Square sushi buffet, Brookline Wok • Romanized : containing Romanized Chinese characters that are not names of a person or names that indicate relationships. Here are some common examples: – Examples: Lu Fu Zi, Wei Shi Jia, Shu Da Xia restaurant, Hai Di Lao Garden, Din Tai Fung, Yi Mei Deli

blocks.en: Ambiance : refers to a kind of atmosphere which makes customers feel comfortable and enjoy the dining experience, or it often indicates family or friendship, or being homesick, which shortens the psychological distance between the restaurant and the patrons. • 人名 : 包括姓氏，名字，全名或者昵称。下面是一些例子: – 餐馆名带有姓氏：林记烧腊，李记面馆，王家园，张师傅厨房 – 餐馆名带有名字：亚轩十八，威威，嘉嘉海鲜菜馆 – 餐馆名带有全名：李明餐厅，刘一手火锅 – 餐馆名带有昵称：六婆串串香，阿庆东北饺子馆 • 特色 : 一般指带有一个餐馆名有特点的菜系，食物类型或者饮食形式。下面是一些例子： – 餐馆名带有肉类，海鲜，豆腐种类：北京烤鸭餐厅，小肥羊，海鲜渔村，韩式豆腐汤 – 餐馆名带有烧烤或者自助：老村长烧烤屋，巴西烤肉，老友撸串店，金钱豹自助餐厅 – 餐馆名带有饮茶奶茶：时光奶茶 – 餐馆名带有点心：翠华茶餐厅，乐茶轩，一点心 – 餐厅名带有包子饺子：南翔小笼包，东北饺子馆 – 餐厅名带有火锅或者特色锅煲：蒙古火锅，砂锅居，成都冷锅，韩国海鲜豆腐煲 – 餐厅名带有米饭和面粉：小明炒饭，湖南米粉，绿色吴家粥铺，嘉和粥点，碰记热干面 – 餐厅名带有伊斯兰特色，素食标签，或者其他文化标签：清真拉面，素食天地，阿曼尼萨汗美食城 – 餐厅名带有小吃：天津特色小吃，江浙小吃 • 最高级和其他积极的修饰语: 指代使用比较级，最高级的修饰语还有使用积极正能量的修饰词。以下是一些例子： – 餐馆名指代好以及其比较级最高级的单词：京城第一，完美中餐厅，最好拉面店，顶好餐厅 – 餐馆名有指代味道好的修饰词：美味家园，好吃小馆，鲜芋仙，香喷喷厨房 – 餐馆名有金，银，玉，翡，翠，鼎，御, 宝等这些: 金山餐厅，聚宝盆，玉园，东方明珠 – 餐馆名有好运的修饰词比如发，8，八，好运：好运楼，发祥地，88酒家 – 餐馆名可以激起美好的期待：快乐家庭，阳光宫殿，好时光咖啡，圆满小厨，向日葵餐厅 – 餐馆名指代丰富富裕比如富，八，发，祥，嘉，聚，旺，和：盛大自助餐，富国餐厅，东方盛宴 – 餐馆名指代皇家和尊贵：御尚坊，帝国餐厅，皇家特供，王朝餐厅，王品牛排 – 餐馆名包含OK：OK拉面
餐馆名包含专业程度：大厨厨房，匠人厨房 – 餐馆名包含积极的意向比如红色，升日，花好月圆：红房子，日升餐厅 • 氛围: 包括暗示环境氛围的词语，一般作为地点的高级表达方式，给顾客一种舒适的体验。以下是一些例子： – 餐馆名包含餐厅和厨房的高级表达方式：：南北小馆、新和小馆、食苑小厨、私房小厨、司膳房、御膳房 – 餐馆名包含古代高级地点词汇：美食轩、金鼎轩、凌波轩、湘德楼、海鲜酒家、川坝子酒楼、峨眉酒家、听涛阁、逐帆亭、望海楼、拾贝坊、采菱榭、御风堂、浣沙居 – 餐馆名包含带有艺术表达气息的地点名称：楼上花园、御香园、万秀园餐厅、熙春园餐厅 • 双关等创意题目: 包括双关、谐音等等各种有创意的修辞方法。以下是一些例子： – 餐馆名包含双关或者谐音：四面八方（含有“面”，适合当面馆的名字），海食蜃楼（取自成语“海市蜃楼”），与食俱进（取自成语“与时俱进”），美食美客（取自成语“每时每刻”），天外飞鲜（取自成语“天外飞仙”） – 餐馆名包含文化：老友记（电视剧名，也泛指老友相聚）、三味真火（“三味”可以指世间一切美味，也是红孩儿的看家本领；“真”字有真诚、真实的意思；“火”字寓意生意红火）、楚留香（本是人名，同时“留香”也意味着留下香气） • 文化: 指餐厅名字中含有中华文化或美国文化符号或代表。以下是一些例子： – 餐馆名包含动物：熊猫园，龙酒家, 凤凰茶楼 – 餐馆名包含历史古迹：长城饭店，天坛，金门 – 餐馆名包含植物：松鹤楼，梅花楼，绿竹园 – 餐馆名包含著名历史人物：小平饭店，秦始皇大酒楼 – 餐馆名包含朝代名称：唐朝饭店 – 餐馆名包含工艺品: 大红灯笼，青瓷园 • 地点: 名字中含有与中国，亚洲，或其他地区、城市、街道的名字。以下是一些例子： – 餐馆名包含中国或亚洲：中国餐厅，亚洲楼，华园，华明，中 – 餐馆名包含城市名：北京园，奉天小馆，川湘味，金粤园 – 餐馆名包含其他地方或街道名：曼哈顿小吃, 芬威楼 English Translation • Personal name: includes surname, first name, full name, or nicknames. Here are some examples: – restaurant names containing surnames: Lin’s shaola, Lee’s Noodle restaurant, Wang’s garden, Chef Zhang’s Kitchen – restaurant names come with first names: Asia Pavillion 18, Weiwei, Jiajia Seafood Restaurant – restaurant names with full name: Li Ming Restaurant, Liu Yishou Hotpot – restaurant names with a nickname: Liu Po Delicious Skewers, Ah Qing Northeast Dumpling House • Specialty: Generally refers to the cuisine, food types or dietary forms that are unique to a region or restaurant. Here are some examples – Restaurant names include types of meat, seafood, and tofu: Beijing Roast Duck Restaurant, Little Sheep, Seafood Fishing Village, Korean Tofu Soup – Restaurants with barbecue or buffet in their names: Old Village Chief’s BBQ House, Brazilian BBQ, Old Friend’s Skewers, Golden Leopard Buffet Restaurant – restaurant names containing Yumcha or milk tea: Time Milk Tea – Restaurant names indicating dim sum: Tsui Wah Tea Restaurant, Happy Tea House, One Dim Sum – Restaurant names with steamed buns and dumplings: Nanxiang Steamed Dumplings, Northeast Dumpling House – restaurant names containing hot pot or special pot: Mongolian hot pot, clay pot, Chengdu cold pot, Korean seafood tofu pot – Restaurant names with rice and flour: Xiaoming Fried Rice, Hunan Rice Noodles, Green Wu’s Porridge Shop, Jiahe Porridge and Snacks, Pengji Hot Dry
Noodles – restaurant names with religous indications, vegetarian labels, or other cultural labels: Halal Ramen, Vegetarian World, Oman
Nisa Khan Food City . – restaurant names containing snacks: Tianjin special snacks, Jiangsu and Zhejiang snacks • Superlatives and other positive modifiers: refers to the use of comparatives, superlative modifiers and modifiers that use positive energy. Here are some examples: – Restaurant names refer to good and its comparative superlative words: No. 1 in Beijing, Perfect Chinese restaurant, Best Ramen Shop, Top Good Restaurant – restaurant names with modifiers that refer to good taste: Delicious Home, Delicious Bistro, Fresh Taro Fairy, Fragrant Kitchen – Restaurant names include gold, silver, jade, jade, emerald, tripod, imperial, treasure, etc.: Jinshan Restaurant, Cornucopia, Jade Garden, Dongfang Ming
beads – restaurant names with good luck modifiers such as 8, Good Luck: Good Luck Building, Lucky Origin, 88 Restaurant – Restaurant names that can arouse good expectations: Happy Family, Sunshine Palace, Good Time Coffee, Perfect Kitchen, Sunflower
Restaurant – Restaurant names refer to richness and opulence such as ”rich”, ”fortune”, ”lucky”, ”beautiful”, ”Union”, ”prosperous”, and: Shanda Buffet, Rich Country Cuisine
Hall, Oriental Feast – Restaurant names refer to royalty and nobility: Royall Kitchen, Empire Restaurant, Royal Special, Dynasty Restaurant, King Steak – restaurant names containing ”OK”: OK Ramen – restaurant name contains professional level: Chef Kitchen, Artisan Kitchen – Restaurant names containing positive connotations such as red, rising sun, flowers and full moon: Red House, Sunrise Restaurant • Atmosphere: Including words that imply the atmosphere of the environment, generally used as a high-level expression of a place to give customers a comfortable experience. Here are some examples: – Restaurant names include advanced expressions of restaurants and kitchens: North and South Bistro, New Peace Bistro, Snack Garden Kitchen, Private Kitchen, ROyal Kitchen, Imperial Kitchen – The names of restaurants include ancient high-end location words: Delicacy Pavillion, Golden Ding Pavillion,WavesHouse, Hunan Virtue Building, Seafood Restaurant, Chuanbazi Restaurant, Emei Restaurant, Hearing Waves Pavilion, Chasing Boat Pavilion, Seaview Tower, Shell Picking Bistro, Lotus Picking Pavilion, Royal Wind Hall, Gauze Washing Home – Restaurant names include place names with artistic expression: Upstairs Garden, Royal Fragrance Garden, Million Beauty Garden Restaurant, Bright Spring Garden Restaurant • Creative topics such as puns: including puns, homonyms and other creative rhetorical methods. Here are some examples: – Restaurant names contain puns or homophones: Four Directions and Eight Places (In the Chinese idiom Si Mian Ba Fang, whose literal translation if ”Four Directions and Eight Places”, the character of Mian is the same as the character for noodle, hence making the name suitable for a noodle restaurant), Food Mirage (taken from the Chinese idiom ”mirage”), Advance with Food (taken from the Chinese idiom ”advance with the times”), Gourmet food and delicious food (Romanization ”Mei Shi Mei Ke”) (from the idiom ”every moment”(Romanization ”Mei Shi Mei Ke”). The Chinese characters in the idiom are replaced with characters of similar pronunciation in the restaurant name), Freshness from the Sky (from the Chinese idiom ”Tianwai Feixian”) – restaurant names containing cultural or media symbols: Friends (the name of the TV series, also generally refers to the gathering of old friends), Three Zhen Fires (”Sanwei” can refer to all the delicious food in the world, and is also Honghaier’s special skill; the word ”zhen” means sincerity and authenticity ;The word ”fire” means business is booming), Chu Liuxiang (originally a person’s name, and ”Liuxiang” also means leaving a fragrance) • Culture: Refers to restaurants whose names contain symbols or representatives of Chinese culture or American culture. Here are some examples: – Restaurant names include animals: Panda Garden, Dragon Restaurant, Phoenix Tea House – The restaurant name includes historical monuments: Great Wall Hotel, Temple of Heaven, Golden Gate – The restaurant name contains plants: Songhe Tower, Plum Blossom Tower, Green Bamboo Garden – The restaurant names include famous historical figures: Xiaoping Hotel, Qin Shihuang Restaurant – The restaurant name contains the name of the dynasty: Tang Dynasty Hotel – The restaurant name contains handicrafts: Red Lantern, Celadon Garden • Location: The name contains names related to China, Asia, or other regions, cities, and streets. Here are some examples: – restaurant names containing words like ”Chinese” or ”Asian”: Chinese Restaurant, Asia House, China Garden, China Bright – restaurant names include city names: Beijing Garden, Fengtian Restaurant, Sichuan and Hunan Flavor, Jinyue Garden – Restaurant names contain other place or street names: Manhattan Eats, Fenway House

blocks.en: C.1 Interview Procedure

blocks.en:
We conducted semi-structured interviews with ten ACR owners.
We refer to the participants from R1 to R10.
Details for each respondent can be found in Table 7 . We follow the guideline 10 10 10 https://www.mass.gov/doc/massachusetts-rural-towns-list/download from Massachusetts State Office of Rural Health to classify the areas. To attain a diverse sample, we employed a stratified sampling approach to ensure that we reach owners from both urban and rural areas.
We also sampled restaurants based on whether their Mandarin and English names were a close match or a mismatch.
R9 was the only restaurant that didn’t have a Mandarin name.
blocks.zh:
我们和10个ACR业主进行了半结构化的访谈.
我们指的是从R1到R10的参与者.
每个答复者的详细情况见表7。 我们遵循准则10 10 https://www.mas.gov/doc/massachusetts-turm-towns-list/download 从马萨诸塞州农村卫生局对这些地区进行分类。 为了获得不同的样本,我们采用了分层抽样方法,以确保我们接触到城市和农村地区的业主。
我们还根据他们的普通话和英语名称是接近匹配还是不匹配来抽样.
R9是唯一没有普通话名的餐厅。

blocks.en:
We reached out to the selected restaurants through walk-ins or calls.
Each interview was held in Mandarin and lasted around 30 minutes to an hour.
We asked owners how the Mandarin and English restaurant names were created.
We also asked questions about personalizing the names to different customer groups, how the restaurant location impacted the naming process, and how the restaurant reflects aspects of the owner’s heritage and identity.
Appendix contains our interview guide.
blocks.zh:
我们通过走进或电话联系了选定的餐馆。
每次采访都用普通话进行,持续了大约30分钟到1小时.
我们问所有者如何创建普通话和英语餐厅名称。
我们还问及如何将名字个性化给不同的顾客团体、餐厅地点如何影响命名过程以及餐厅如何反映业主遗产和身份的各个方面。
附录载有我们的访谈指南。

blocks.en:
Since a majority of participants didn’t feel comfortable with recording the conversations, we had a designated note-taker record detailed notes in English, which we used to analyze the interviews.
Three authors went through the notes and coded them for themes using affinity diagramming, a popular analysis method in user interface design Lucero (2015) where text data is segmented into notes and then clustered into groups.
Through multiple iterations, along with periodic discussions with
the rest of the research team, we identified several key themes that impact restaurant naming decisions.

blocks.en: C.3 Expanded Interview Results
blocks.zh: C.3 扩大的访谈结果

blocks.en: C.3.1 Impact of Customer Group
blocks.zh: C.3.1 客户集团的影响

blocks.en: All owners strategically think about their customer groups, especially in regards to age and cultural background, observing how their customers change over time. For example, R10 caters their food to the local rural population, which is less than 1% Chinese, while R5 caters their food to the international Chinese students who come to Chinatown and want to try new foods.
blocks.zh: 所有业主都从战略角度考虑其客户群体,特别是在年龄和文化背景方面,观察其客户随时间的变化。 例如:R10为当地农村人口提供膳食,华人不足1%;而R5为来唐人街想吃新菜的国际华人学生提供膳食.

blocks.en: In many cases, the owners’ awareness of their customer base directly impacted their choice in Chinese and English restaurant names. ACR Mandarin names help attract Chinese-speaking customers. R2 chose their Chinese name to attract Chinese customers who enjoy certain regional dishes, which is made clear in the name. Further, R2 is well-aware that the mismatch in their Chinese and English names denotes two different regions of China, which sparks the curiosity of many of their Chinese customers; “Chinese customers…want to investigate and try it.” About “8-9% of young customers ask where the name is coming from.” All but two ACRs came up with their Chinese names first. R1 noted that “Chinese names are easy to understand, because the “language is very rich,” explaining that their particular Chinese name holds a double meaning.
blocks.zh: 在许多情况下,店主对客户基础的认识直接影响到他们选择中英文餐厅名称。 ACR普通话名帮助吸引会说中文的顾客. R2选择了他们的中文名来吸引享受某些区域菜肴的中国顾客,这名名下就明确了. 此外,R2也清楚地意识到其中英文名的不匹配表示中国的两个不同区域,这引发了中国许多客户的好奇心;“中国客户......希望进行调查和尝试。” 大约“8-9%的年轻顾客问这个名字来自何处”。 除了两个ACR之外,所有的人都先想到了他们的中文名字. R1指出,“中文名称容易理解,因为“语言非常丰富”,解释其特定的中文名称具有双重含义。

blocks.en: Similarly, ACR English restaurant names attract largely American customers. In the case of R9, which only has an English name, there is “no need” for a Chinese name, as it is located in a rural area where “there are no Chinese customers.” Many ACR owners chose their English names because they are familiar and easy to understand for American customers. R2 decided upon their English name first, because the “name tells [American customers] it’s an Asian food.” R6, whose Chinese and English names are mismatches, said of their English name: “We want to accommodate for American taste and have to change to fit their palette.” R4 named their restaurant after a popular movie featuring Chinese characters, saying “it is good to have a simple name to be more acceptable by customers.” Some ACR owners caught onto Western trends of trying new cuisines, and named their restaurants in accordance with the trends. R6’s name brings up associations with a popular Chinese dish at a time where journalists were reporting on it, which “made American customers curious.” R8, whose two names are a close match, expects American customers to google the restaurant name and “be curious about the place.” And for some ACR owners like R1 and R8, the English name plays a more active role, acting as a means to correct misconceptions of Chinese restaurants in America as “cheap, not very good, not clean” (R1). R1’s goal was to “attract westerners, have them try the Chinese food and change their mind,” establishing R1 as a “social destination, not just place to eat.” Accordingly, “Westerners can say the name” and “it sounds sweet” (R1).
blocks.zh: 同样,ACR英文餐厅名称也主要吸引美国顾客. R9只使用英文名称,因此“不需要”中文名称,因为它位于“没有中国客户”的农村地区。 许多ACR所有者选择了他们的英文名字,因为他们对美国客户熟悉并易于理解. R2首先决定了他们的英文名,因为“名字告诉[美国客户]是亚洲食品。 ” R6, 其中文和英文名称不匹配, R4以中国人物为主角的热门电影命名他们的餐厅, 一些ACR的老板抓住了尝试新菜的西方趋势,并根据趋势命名了他们的餐馆. R6的名字在记者报导时, R8, 两人的名字很接近, 希望美国顾客能浏览餐厅名称, 而对于一些ACR业主如R1和R8,英文名扮演了更积极的作用,作为纠正美国中餐馆被误解为"便宜,不甚好,不干净"(R1)的手段. R1的目标是“吸引西方人,让他们尝试中国食物并改变主意 ” , 将R1确立为“社会目的地,而不仅仅是吃东西的地方 ” 。 因此,“西方人可以说这个名字”和“听起来不错”(R1)。

blocks.en: C.3.2 Impact of Location
blocks.zh: C.3.2 地点的影响

blocks.en:
Several ACRs highlighted the importance of opening a restaurant in a “good neighborhood” with “better school districts” (R2).
R3 chose to open her restaurant near a prestigious university to attract students, researchers, and professors.
Those universities have a large group of Chinese international students who regularly eat at Chinese restaurants, motivating the need for a Mandarin name.
R1 opened her restaurant in an area with a lot of development, which happens to be close to her former workplace.
She wanted to “create a place for former co-workers to come and keep in touch” , which was one reason why she incorporated her personal name in both the Mandarin and English restaurant names.
blocks.zh:
一些保护儿童权利协会强调在“好邻里”和“更好的校区”开设一家餐厅的重要性(R2)。
R3选择在有名望的大学附近开设她的餐厅来吸引学生,研究人员和教授.
这些大学拥有一大批中国国际学生,他们经常在中餐馆吃东西,促使人们需要普通话的名字.
R1在一个开发程度高的地区开了她的餐厅,这恰好与她以前的工作场所很相近.
她想“为前同事来此保持联系” ,这是她将她的个人姓名纳入普通话和英语餐厅名称的原因之一。

blocks.en:
We observed a different relationship between location and naming decisions in Boston’s Chinatown, which has the largest concentration of ACRs in Massachusetts.
R7 shared that a restaurant in Chinatown has to be “unique to stand out so that they can have business. There is a lot of competition for the same type of food, and other restaurants have been open for longer.” R7 identified a type of Chinese food that was not being sold in Chinatown. He highlighted aspects of the food in both the Mandarin and English names of his restaurant to stand out from other options in the area.
Chinatown is drastically different from rural areas, where there are very few ACRs.
R9 decided to open a restaurant in a rural town to “escape Chinatown.” He and his partner picked their current location because it is “adventurous” , and they wanted to “start a new life with more freedom.” The newfound freedom is reflected in R9’s choice of naming the restaurant in memory of his daughter and deciding not to create a Mandarin name.

R7分享道,唐人街的一家餐馆必须“独出一格,才能做生意。 同类食品竞争激烈,其他餐厅开放时间也更长了。” R7识别出一种没有在唐人街发售的中式食品. 他用他的餐馆的普通话和英文名称强调了食物的方方面面,以突出该地区其他选择。

blocks.en: C.3.3 Impact of Personal Experience
blocks.zh: C.3.3 个人经验的影响

blocks.en: A few ACR owners shared how their personal experience, including their family, origin, and personality, influenced their choice of restaurant names. Both R3 and R9 included the names of their daughters to “ show love ”. R1 included her Chinese given name in the ACR name to memorize her dad who was “ an artist who came up with the name ” (R1). R1’s dad passed away in China while she was still studying in America and did not make it to see him as the only daughter. A few owners (R1, R2, R4) also mark their or their partners’ origin in the ACR names such as “ Hunan ”, “ Taiwanese ”. R1 shared that she did this to “ introduce my hometown to this area ” and expressed, “ I miss my family in the hometown .” 6 out of 10 respondents are from Fuzhou City, which is a community has long been known for its significant presence in the Chinese restaurant industry in the United States. It is interesting to see that none of the six ACRs owned by Fuzhounese encode their origins in the names. R8, an active member from the Fuzhouese community, confirmed our observation that most ACRs in the state are owned by immigrants from Fuzhou City, Fujian Providence. At last, we found that some owners wanted the name to “ be personal ” (R1) and “ become a form of self expression ” (R7). R7, who decorated and named his ACR in a unique and fashionable manner, shared that he “ did not care if other people like the name ” when he created and copyrighted the name. However, some owners such as R3 had a different opinion, sharing that she did not like “ her identity to be encoded in the restaurant names .”
blocks.zh: 一些ACR老板分享了他们的个人经历,包括家庭、出身和个性,如何影响他们选择餐厅名称。 R3和R9都列出了女儿的名字,以“显示爱......”。 R1在ACR名字中包括了她的中文取名,以纪念她的父亲,她是“一位想出名字的艺术家”(R1)。 R1的父亲在中国去世,当时她仍在美国留学,没有让他成为唯一的女儿. 少数业主(R1,R2,R4)还用 " 湖南 " 、 " 台湾人 " 等ACR名称标出其伴侣的出处。 R1说,她这样做是为了 " 将我的家乡介绍到这个地区 " ,并表示 " 我怀念我的家乡家庭。 10个受访者中有6个来自福州市,而福州市长期以来一直以在美国的中餐馆业占有重要地位而闻名。 有趣的是,Fuzhounese拥有的六个ACR中没有一个将它们的起源编码在名字中。 R8,来自福州人社区的积极成员,证实了我们的观点,即州内大部分ACR由福建普罗维登斯的福州市移民拥有. 我们终于发现,有些业主希望这个名字“是个人的......”(R1)和“成为一种自我表达形式......”(R7)。 R7以独特和时尚的方式装饰并命名了他的ACR,他分享他创作和版权时“不在乎其他人是否喜欢这个名字......”。 R3等一些业主持不同看法,
